name: Tina Kotek

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek's campaign says shelter beds were added or maintained and households helped to stay housed, citing more than 6,200 beds and nearly 26,000 households.
positions.excerpt: added or maintained more than 6,200 shelter beds and helped nearly 26,000 households stay housed.

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists defending against tariff taxes, new barriers to health care and cuts to SNAP food assistance among her aims.
positions.excerpt: Defend against Trump’s tariff taxes, new barriers to health care, cuts to SNAP food assistance

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists defending the Oregon Health Plan from federal Medicaid cuts among her aims.
positions.excerpt: Defend the Oregon Health Plan from Trump’s Medicaid cuts

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek's campaign says mental health and addiction treatment was expanded by creating more than 1,660 new treatment beds.
positions.excerpt: expanded mental health and addiction treatment by creating more than 1,660 new treatment beds

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists expanding infant and toddler child care and creating a pathway to universal preschool statewide.
positions.excerpt: Expand access to infant and toddler childcare while creating a pathway to universal preschool statewide

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists supporting communities to be climate resilient to wildfire, drought and severe weather.
positions.excerpt: Support communities to be climate resilient to wildfire, drought and extreme weather

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists making sure data centers pay their fair share of energy costs instead of residential customers.
positions.excerpt: make sure data centers pay their fair share of energy costs instead of residential customers footing the bill

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists ensuring Oregonians have access to clean air and water, stronger salmon runs and healthy rivers.
positions.excerpt: Ensure Oregonians have access to clean air and water, stronger salmon runs and healthy rivers

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists protecting homeowners' insurance during wildfires among her aims.
positions.excerpt: protecting homeowners’ insurance during wildfires

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek says she would support Oregon's long-standing strengths in tech manufacturing and agricultural products.
positions.excerpt: support Oregon’s long-standing strengths in tech manufacturing, agricultural products

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists supporting startups, small and local businesses, and Oregon entrepreneurs.
positions.excerpt: Support startups, small and local businesses, and Oregon entrepreneurs

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists protecting Oregonians from federal attempts to restrict access to abortion, birth control and gender-affirming care.
positions.excerpt: Protect Oregonians from federal attempts to restrict access to abortion, birth control, and gender-affirming care

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists standing up to ICE and other aggressive federal immigration enforcement.
positions.excerpt: Stand up to ICE and other aggressive federal immigration enforcement

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Building Oregon's Future Together' page, Kotek lists safeguarding Oregon's vote-by-mail system and holding the line against federal overreach.
positions.excerpt: Safeguard Oregon’s trusted and secure vote-by-mail system and hold the line against federal overreach.

positions.statement: On her campaign's 'Progress for Oregon' page, Kotek's campaign says all Oregonians deserve to feel safe in their neighborhoods.
positions.excerpt: All Oregonians deserve to feel safe in their neighborhoods.

positions.statement: OPB reported in November 2025 that Kotek signed the Community Safety Firearms Act, which bans bump stocks, and quoted her statement that it matters to every parent dropping a child off at school.
positions.excerpt: This matters to every parent dropping their kid off at school,

positions.statement: OPB reported in January 2026 that Kotek wanted lawmakers to pass a bill scrapping the entire transportation funding bill she pushed through a 2025 special session.
positions.excerpt: scrapping the entirety of the bill she muscled through in a special session over the summer

positions.statement: KTVZ reported in August 2026 that Kotek announced a $10 million Regional Infrastructure Fund for small Oregon communities and tribes, and quoted her saying infrastructure is where economic development begins.
positions.excerpt: Infrastructure is where economic development begins.

positions.statement: OPB reported in June 2026 that Kotek offered qualified support for some of the tax ideas from her Prosperity Council in a meeting with the council.
positions.excerpt: But Kotek did offer qualified support for some of the ideas in a meeting with the council Thursday.

positions.statement: OPB reported in March 2026 that after a ruling against her union-labor executive order, Kotek said in a statement she still believed it was the right policy for the state at the right time.
positions.excerpt: I continue to believe that this was the right policy for the state at the right time,

collection_notes: Incumbent governor Tina Kotek; identity rests on her campaign site tinafororegon.com (website_verified_via in verified candidate file) and news items naming Gov. Kotek. Items i1-i14 come from two campaign pages (T2) and are the campaign's own listed aims. Governor has no roll-call voting record; bills signed are reported as OPB-attributed positions. OPB transportation article i18 states the 2025 package scrap request; excerpt is a fragment quoting OPB. i20 publication date left null (fetch showed 2026-03-13, URL shows 03-12). Veterans: only 2022 campaign material and legislative letters surfaced, none usable.
